# MuregiScore Technologies

> MuregiScore Technologies is a multi-disciplinary technology solutions umbrella company based in Nairobi, Kenya, engineering mission-critical business software, operational automation, mobile payment rails, and industry-specific platforms across Sub-Saharan Africa.

MuregiScore Technologies operates six specialized engineering divisions focused on real operational bottlenecks rather than off-the-shelf software templates.

## Engineering Divisions

- **Division 01: Business Software**: Multi-tenant CRM platforms, client lifecycle management, sales deal pipelines, and automated business workflows engineered for African SMEs. Includes BullMQ background job queues, Redis caching, and audit trails.
  - Architecture Model: [Core CRM GitHub Model](https://github.com/Muregis/Core-Crm-model)
- **Division 02: Education Technology**: End-to-end institutional administration supporting CBC (Competency-Based Curriculum) and 8-4-4 structures. Features student records, automated fee reconciliation, report card generation, and algorithmic timetable clash resolution.
  - Live Deployments: [EduCore Platform](https://educore-school-management-system-pi.vercel.app), [EduCore Ratiba Solver](https://educoreratiba.vercel.app)
  - Repositories: [EduCore GitHub](https://github.com/Muregis/educore-school-management-system), [Ratiba Engine GitHub](https://github.com/Muregis/Educore-Ratiba)
- **Division 03: Payments & Integrations**: Financial pipelines connecting directly to telecommunications rails, specializing in Safaricom Daraja M-Pesa STK Push, C2B automated webhooks, Paybill & Till transaction reconciliation, and bulk B2C disbursements.
- **Division 04: Industry-Specific Systems**: Agricultural and biological operational tracking systems. Includes livestock digital passports, pedigree lineage tracking, daily milk yield analytics, veterinary regimens, and field inventory.
  - Live Deployment: [Livestock Management App](https://livestock-management-app.vercel.app)
  - Repository: [Livestock App GitHub](https://github.com/Muregis/Livestock-Management-App)
- **Division 05: Websites & Digital Platforms**: High-performance commercial portals engineered for search visibility, speed, mobile accessibility, and lead conversion.
  - Live Deployments: [Sawa Repairs & Solar Solutions](https://sawa-solar-solution-website.vercel.app), [Gracious Love Academy Portal](https://graciousloveacademy-school-website.vercel.app)
- **Division 06: Bespoke Engineering**: Tailored software engineering for non-standard enterprise challenges requiring custom relational schemas, constraint optimization algorithms, and high-availability SLAs.

## Key Technical Specifications

- **Architectural Paradigms**: Multi-tenant data isolation, asynchronous message queues (BullMQ/Redis), event-driven microservices.
- **Payment Protocols**: Safaricom Daraja REST APIs (STK Push Express, C2B validation & confirmation webhooks, B2C bulk payment API), Paystack integration.
- **Algorithmic Solvers**: Timetable generation using modified FET constraint logic tailored to Kenyan CBC school constraints.
- **Frontend & Backend Technologies**: React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Redis, TailwindCSS, high-contrast accessible design systems.
